# `iscope_start_view`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Switch the device into a view mode (star, scenery, moon, sun, planet, solar system), optionally with a target.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (full command-socket call; shared diagnostic writes; 64-bit and 32-bit builds) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xde500 (64-bit build); firmware 9.75 members from the 9.75 reports |

Starts the requested view worker. Changes view, camera, page and control state, can stop the previous worker and exposure, and can move the focuser. On wide-camera-capable models (star mode) the request may be relayed to the other camera process, in which case the reply is the relayed reply rather than a locally built one. A success reply means the request was accepted and the worker launched, not that the view is ready. Downstream device and driver error codes are not limited to the table below. The grade reflects the whole request/reply path, which reaches the shared diagnostic logger; it does not by itself mean the method changes device settings. Firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0 adds the members goto_capt_type, goto_capture_settings and stack_exp_ms and the codes 104 and 209 on them; their types and meaning were not decoded. Mosaic goto now has a source mode that restarts a normal stack after the goto (see stacking.md).

Side effects: Saves target and autosave state, changes view/page/control state, may stop the prior worker and exposure, may open and move the focuser, sets the working indicator (64-bit build), and may relay requests to the second camera process, each wait up to 10000 ms with no total bound established. Every call also performs shared request/reply diagnostic logging.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"iscope_start_view"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | yes | - | Required object. Missing, null, scalar or array params give 107 (checked after the ViewPlan guard). A positional array wrapping the object is not accepted. Unknown members are ignored. [READ] |
| `params.mode` | string | yes | - | Required string naming the view mode: star, scenery, moon, sun, planet, solar_sys, none (ASCII case-insensitive). Absent, null or wrong type gives 105. An unrecognised string maps to the same internal value as none, which StartView rejects with 204; accepted ids are 0-5. [READ] |
| `params.target_type` | string | no | - | Optional string, read only when mode is solar_sys: moon, sun or planet. Missing or wrong type, or any other name, falls back to sun. Ignored for other modes. [READ] |
| `params.target_ra_dec` | array<number> | no | [-999, -999] (sentinel, no target) | Optional two-element array: RA in decimal hours, then Dec in decimal degrees (READ: stored unconverted; the goto worker multiplies RA by 15). Coordinates are taken as epoch of date (JNow), not J2000 (INFERRED: the firmware's own plan path precesses J2000 targets to the current date before starting a view; no epoch flag exists), so a client SHOULD precess J2000 positions first. Each element is an integer or float token; extra elements ignored. Missing, non-array, short or malformed arrays generate no error; the first coordinate may be applied even if the second fails (no rollback). No range checks. [READ] |
| `params.target_name` | string | no | - | Optional string, default empty. Missing or wrong type ignored. A nonempty name is passed through filename sanitising before being saved as target and autosave state; the exact normalisation is not established. No length limit in the parser. [READ] |
| `params.lp_filter` | boolean\|integer | no | False | Optional boolean or integer (0 false, nonzero true); other types ignored. The 64-bit build forces the flag false when the stack setting for auto light-pollution enhancement is false. [READ] |
| `params.star_type` | integer | no | -1 | Optional integer; wrong type ignored. No enum or range check; valid values and meaning not established. Not sent by the app. [READ] |
| `params.mosaic` | object | if mosaic.angle: required when mosaic.scale is present | - | Optional object, parsed only after both leading target_ra_dec elements parsed successfully. Absent, null or non-object is ignored. [READ] |
| `params.mosaic.star_map_angle` | number | no | -999 | Optional number, default -999 (sentinel). A present but non-numeric value gives 102. No range check. Degrees (INFERRED); zero direction and sign unresolved. When absent, capture setup resets the mosaic parameters (scale 1, angle 0), so a mosaic needs all three members (INFERRED). [READ] |
| `params.mosaic.scale` | number | no | -999 | Optional number, default -999 (sentinel). A present but non-numeric value gives 102. When absent, angle is not read. No range check or clamp. Dimensionless multiplier of the camera frame size for the mosaic canvas; mosaic enabled when abs(scale) > 1.01 or abs(angle) > 0.1. [READ] |
| `params.mosaic.angle` | number | no | -999 | Number, read only when scale is present and parsed; then missing, null or non-numeric gives 102. Otherwise ignored (default -999). No bounds. Degrees (INFERRED, not established by the parser); truncated to an integer for the grid planner. [READ] |
| `params.selected_cam` | string | no | - | Optional string: View or SecondView (case-insensitive). Read only on the main-process star path with wide-camera support; there a present non-string gives 105 and an unknown name 209. Ignored on other paths. Missing keeps the current selection. [READ] |
| `params.wide_mosaic_angle` | number | no | -999 | Optional number; malformed ignored. Read only for the wide-camera process on the star path. Degrees (INFERRED). [READ] |
| `params.main_stack_exp_us` | integer | no | -1 | 64-bit build only: optional integer exposure override read only for the wide-camera process on the star path. Missing or wrong type sets -1; values <= 0 normalise to -1. Microseconds (INFERRED from the name). Not sent by the app; a main-process relay may inject it. [READ] |
| `params.goto_capt_type` | any | no | - | Firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0: optional goto setting. Type, range and effect were not decoded; 104 and 209 are the reported codes. [READ; type unresolved] |
| `params.goto_capture_settings` | any | no | - | Firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0: optional goto setting. Type, range and effect were not decoded; 104 and 209 are the reported codes. [READ; type unresolved] |
| `params.stack_exp_ms` | any | no | - | Firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0: optional goto setting. Type, range and effect were not decoded; 104 and 209 are the reported codes. [READ; type unresolved] |

## Reply

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jsonrpc` | string | no | - | (both) Added by the socket layer (reply object constructor), not the handler fragment. Normally present; absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply. Receivers MUST NOT require it. Fixed value `"2.0"`. [READ; also OBSERVED on the wire (2026-10-12)] |
| `Timestamp` | string | no | - | (both) Decimal string `<seconds>.<nanoseconds>` with exactly nine fractional digits, formatted with `%ld.%09ld` from clock_gettime clock id 1. Linux clock id 1 is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so the value is monotonic time, not wall-clock or Unix time (INFERRED from the clock id). On replies it is added by the socket layer and is normally present; receivers MUST NOT require it on replies (absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply). On events it is always written by the event constructor. [READ; wire shape also OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | (success) The request method, echoed. [READ] |
| `result` | integer | yes | - | (success) For these methods the result is the integer 0. Fixed value `0`. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | yes | - | (success) Fixed value `0`. [READ] |
| `id` | any | yes | - | (success) Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | if the request had an id and a string method (handler errors and 103), except a locally built stop_func relay failure | - | (error) The request method, echoed. Absent on dispatcher errors 100 and 200 and on a stop_func relay failure. [READ] |
| `error` | string | yes | - | (error) Message looked up from the code; unknown codes yield "fail to operate". [READ] |
| `code` | integer | yes | - | (error) Nonzero. A requested code of 0 is coerced to 207. [READ] |
| `id` | any | yes | - | (error) The request id echoed with its JSON type; null on dispatcher errors 100 and 200, where it is the only way to recognise the reply and cannot be matched to a request. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 536 | A ViewPlan worker is running (checked before params; also from camera selection if a non-dual plan starts in a race) | `view plan is already running` |
| 107 | params missing, null or not an object | `expected object param` |
| 105 | mode missing or not a string; or selected_cam present but not a string on its active branch | `expected string param` |
| 102 | mosaic.star_map_angle or mosaic.scale malformed, or mosaic.angle missing or malformed when scale is present | `invalid params` |
| 204 | Mode id above 5 (none, or an unrecognised mode string) | `out of limit` |
| 209 | selected_cam names an unknown camera | `invalid value` |
| 109 | Camera lookup is negative after a successful camera selection | `unexpected param` |
| 524 | Wide-camera star path requested while the main view function is running, not asleep, and the stack status query is false | `function conflict` |
| 318 | No open camera when the star stage is started | `device not connected` |
| 212 | Named worker could not be started | `fail to create thread` |
| 203 | Guider can_goto response contains result false | `equipment is moving` |
| 300 | Relay to the other process has no user-data context | `internal error` |
| 207 | A downstream failure left the error code zero | `fail to operate` |
| 104 | Firmware 9.75: a new goto member has the wrong type (association INFERRED) | `expected int` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Downstream StartView, ViewStarSleep and relay failures serialise the thread error code; their code set is not established. One caller branch can append two error fragments (duplicate error/code members).

## Example

Request, star-view - Start star mode on the first camera with a target (values invented):

```json
{"id":21,"method":"iscope_start_view","params":{"mode":"star","selected_cam":"View","target_ra_dec":[12,30],"target_name":"Example target","lp_filter":false}}
```

Request, scenery-view - Start scenery mode:

```json
{"id":22,"method":"iscope_start_view","params":{"mode":"scenery"}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"iscope_start_view","result":0,"code":0,"id":21}
```

Reply, plan-running:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"iscope_start_view","error":"view plan is already running","code":536,"id":23}
```
